pages.title: Snaking.io
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Snaking.io has you guide a snake that grows by eating smaller snakes. Earn gold and spend it on speed, strength, and resistance upgrades. Work through the stages, collect trophies, and unlock additional snakes as your growing predator becomes more powerful.

pages.title: Flip Duel
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Flip Duel turns backflips into a parkour challenge built around timing and accurate landings. Link skills through the solo adventure, compete with a friend in local duels, or try FreeStyle. Mistimed flips produce ragdoll crashes as you tackle the landing zones.

pages.title: Collect Brainrot Arena
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Collect Brainrot Arena mixes collecting with base defense and theft. Gather Lucky Blocks to discover Brainrots, improve your collection, and stop rivals taking your valuable finds. Move around the multiplayer arena while deciding when to buy, steal, or protect what you already own.

pages.title: Juice Merge
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Juice Merge lets you combine matching glasses to discover more elaborate drinks. Send glasses onto the table and merge identical recipes to free space. Keep the surface from filling completely while unlocking the full drink collection and building your score.

pages.title: Power Puzzle
pages.creator: HDCorp
pages.description: Power Puzzle asks you to supply buildings through an electrical network. Connect generators to the right nodes and plan how power travels across the grid. Limited connections make efficient routing important as you work out how to light every building.

pages.title: Fireboy & Watergirl 7: and Friends
pages.creator: Septimaniac
pages.description: Fireboy & Watergirl 7: and Friends adds three helpers to the duo's temple exploration. Coordinate the characters, operate switches and levers, and collect diamonds across 36 stages. Play alone or with a friend while aiming for quick, complete puzzle solutions.

pages.title: Grow a Garden 3D
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Grow a Garden 3D lets you plant seeds and develop a garden of magical trees. Move around to buy, plant, collect, and sell while watching the garden expand. Explore its seasonal setting and customize your character between tending the plants.

pages.title: Kaboom Miner
pages.creator: CoreCraft
pages.description: Kaboom Miner challenges you to destroy fifty explosive crates in a rock-filled environment. Use bombs, falling stones, and changes to the terrain to start chain reactions. Plan how each explosion will spread while avoiding the dangers created by your own demolition.

pages.title: Arrows Puzzle Escape
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Arrows Puzzle Escape presents mazes of arrows whose directions cause them to block one another. Study the arrangement and work out an order that opens escape routes. Each puzzle asks you to untangle the jam by understanding which arrows obstruct the others.

pages.title: Brainrot Cleaning
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Brainrot Cleaning puts you to work scrubbing up messes connected with meme characters. Tackle cleaning tasks in the Italian Brainrot and underwater modes, using the available interactions to remove the dirt. Work through each messy scene until it is cleaned up.

pages.title: Mahjong Connect Majong Class
pages.creator: wavegame
pages.description: Mahjong Connect Majong Class challenges you to locate identical mahjong tiles and connect them for removal. Search the board for available pairs, then clear them to reduce the layout. Continue identifying matching designs as you work toward eliminating the tiles.

pages.title: Wacky Wheels
pages.creator: Shanaya
pages.description: Wacky Wheels has you drive through unusual tracks under a time limit. Drift around tight bends, dodge swinging hammers, and collect stars before the countdown expires. Adapt your steering to the changing course themes and obstacles as you progress through the levels.

pages.title: Cards Match Puzzle
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Cards Match Puzzle gives you a grid for arranging card combinations. Score by making three-card sequences or groups of four matching values, using jokers to fill useful gaps. Frozen cards and score multipliers add further decisions to the placement puzzle.

pages.title: Galaxy Carnage
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Galaxy Carnage sends waves of enemy ships and bosses against your starship. Maneuver through the attack while firing lasers, activating a shield, and using a powerful death ray. Your ship upgrades automatically as you continue fighting the alien waves.

pages.title: Easy Obby Jump and Run Challenge Online
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Easy Obby Jump and Run Challenge Online asks you to climb a platforming course full of traps. Move, jump, and dash between surfaces while avoiding the obstacles on the way upward. Keep gaining height as you try to reach the top.

pages.title: Train Master
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Train Master puts you in control of a train collecting passengers along city and countryside tracks. Hold to move and release as needed to manage the journey. Avoid collisions with cars or people while working toward improving your train.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Candy Wheel Level Pack
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Candy Wheel Level Pack has you fire sweets at a rotating target. Form groups of at least three matching candies to remove them, using bombs or time-stopping power-ups when useful. Clear stages for coins that open additional levels.

pages.title: Family Tree Puzzle
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Family Tree Puzzle gives you relationship clues and asks you to reconstruct a family's ancestry. Work out who belongs in each position and connect the relatives correctly. Combine information from the clues until the completed tree fits every family relationship.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies War
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Plants Vs Zombies War is a tower-defense battle using plants to stop advancing zombies. Check each plant's cost and attack before deciding how to defend the field. Learn the setup through the opening tutorial and plan against fifteen different zombie types.

pages.title: Magic Printer
pages.creator: zzgames
pages.description: Magic Printer puts you behind a shop counter producing requested goods for animal customers. Print their orders and earn gold for the work you complete. Spend the proceeds on equipment improvements and decorations as you develop the appearance and operation of the shop.

pages.title: Trolley fun
pages.creator: Dorfer Games OU
pages.description: Trolley fun has you run a goods train connecting cities while bandits threaten the route. Gather resources and improve the train so it can withstand their attacks. Keep the transport operation moving while strengthening your defenses against the raiders.

pages.title: Find Toys By Car
pages.creator: ravel
pages.description: Find Toys By Car gives you a remote-controlled toy vehicle and a rescue mission. Drive around searching for toys concealed in different hiding places. Explore with the little car to locate the missing toys and bring the search to a successful end.

pages.title: Scary Memory Halloween
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Scary Memory Halloween asks you to turn over cards and find pairs of matching spooky symbols. Remember the creatures and images revealed by earlier flips to choose the right partners. Clear the Halloween-themed memory board by uncovering every matching pair.

pages.title: Organization Princess
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Organization Princess presents untidy spaces and a set of objects that need arranging. Move the items into positions that create an organized layout. Each scenario challenges you to decide where everything belongs and how the available space can hold it neatly.

pages.title: Dots and Boxes
pages.creator: CoolMath Games
pages.description: Dots and Boxes pits you against the computer on a grid of dots. Draw horizontal or vertical connections and claim a point whenever you complete a box. Closing a square gives another turn, so plan your lines to finish with more boxes.

pages.title: ChooChoo Charles Friends Defense
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: ChooChoo Charles Friends Defense challenges you to shoot monsters, including the possessed train Charles. Aim at the threats and fire to take them down as the survival action unfolds. Keep your shots focused on the enemies appearing in the defense battle.

pages.title: Glamour BeachLife
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Glamour BeachLife follows Olivia through a summer fashion session centered on swimwear. Combine beach clothing into casual daytime looks or more glamorous party outfits. Browse the wardrobe and accessories to create the different warm-weather styles featured in her beach-life makeover.

pages.title: Motoracer vs Huggy
pages.creator: Berezka
pages.description: Motoracer vs Huggy asks you to run down blue Huggy monsters with a motorcycle. Steer toward your targets while avoiding bomb-carrying Kisi characters and other obstacles. Use nitro and the rear-view option as you try to increase your monster-hitting total.

pages.title: Ellie Easter Adventure
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Ellie Easter Adventure begins with searching for an Easter egg and decorating it in bright colors. Help care for an injured bunny, then prepare Ellie's makeup and clothing. Complete the holiday activities to get her ready for the celebration.

pages.title: Sort Fruits
pages.creator: HyHyGames
pages.description: Sort Fruits asks you to group identically colored fruit inside tubes. Transfer pieces between containers until each color is gathered together. Think through the order of your moves so the available tube space remains useful while you complete each sorting puzzle.

pages.title: Mini Planet - Kids & Toddlers Educational Games
pages.creator: Amin Abdinejad
pages.description: Mini Planet - Kids & Toddlers Educational Games offers a collection of activities about subjects including letters and animals. Explore the planet's different games to practice recognizing English characters and discovering domestic animals, wildlife, and dinosaurs through their themed interactions.

pages.title: HyperDoll
pages.description: HyperDoll puts a sword-carrying stickman under your control in close-quarters battles. Drag to direct the character and swing the weapon into enemies. Guide the superhero through the fighting while using the movement of the sword to defeat opposing figures.

pages.title: Royal Couple Halloween Party
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Royal Couple Halloween Party asks you to dress royal pairs for trick-or-treating. Search the wardrobes and create costumes for each couple before their fantasyland outing. Combine the available clothes to give the princesses and their partners coordinated Halloween appearances.

pages.title: Gold Tower Defense
pages.creator: BUSIDOL
pages.description: Gold Tower Defense tasks you with protecting a gold supply by placing towers in designated positions. Stop monsters through eighty story stages and collect stars from victories. Use the rewards and Tower Draw system to strengthen your defensive lineup.

pages.title: Sneak Runner 3D
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Sneak Runner 3D challenges you to reach an exit door without alerting the enemies in your way. Slip past guards and watch for laser traps along the route. Each level introduces a more difficult arrangement to negotiate on the way out.

pages.title: Zombie Mission 11
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Zombie Mission 11 takes the series underwater, where infected sea creatures join the zombie threat. Fight through the new setting using weapons, grenades, and special attacks. Coordinate two characters as you explore the undersea stages with their additional vehicles and mechanics.

pages.title: Among Float Connect
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Among Float Connect asks you to pair identical character tiles using paths with no more than two right-angle turns. Remove every pair before time expires. Some stages shift the remaining tiles in different directions, changing the connections available across its 27 levels.

pages.title: Pounce.sh
pages.creator: Tabortop
pages.description: Pounce.sh is a turn-based stealth contest for two players trying to hunt one another. Move carefully and choose when to strike while considering where your opponent may be. Each decision can leave you tracking the enemy or exposed as the next target.

pages.title: Funny Kitty Care
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Funny Kitty Care has you rescue a stray kitten and help it recover. Wash its dirty coat and treat its wounds until the care sequence is complete. Finish by choosing clothing and accessories to give the rescued cat a new look.

pages.title: Noob vs Hacker Diver Suit
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Noob vs Hacker Diver Suit sends the characters into a forest threatened by rising water. Find and put on the diving suit before going underwater, where an unprotected character will drown. Avoid monsters and use double jumps while searching for the equipment.

pages.title: Woodturning Studio
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Woodturning Studio lets you shape a piece of wood with different carving knives. Guide the tools to create a profile, then choose colors and apply varnish. Finish the turning process by decorating the object you have carved from the sample.

pages.title: Jelly Dye
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Jelly Dye gives you colored dyes to apply to jelly shapes. Choose a color and inject it into the corresponding jelly area to build up the design. Continue adding dyes until the different sections form the colored creation you want.

pages.title: Inferno. Meltdown
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Inferno. Meltdown puts you in control of a robotic firefighter responding to blazes around town. Aim the hose, place sprinklers, and navigate burning buildings with explosive hazards. Spraying downward while jumping also lets you use the water stream to gain height.

pages.title: State of Zombies 3
pages.creator: Feig Ltd.
pages.description: State of Zombies 3 offers four characters and forty weapons for fighting through zombie attacks. Move through the action, switch between firearms, and use collected gadgets when needed. Choose equipment to help your character handle the undead enemies in each battle.

pages.title: The Walls
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: The Walls challenges you to navigate among balls of different colors. Absorb ones that match your own color to grow, while avoiding the others. Contact with a mismatched ball ends the game, so choose your route according to the colors ahead.

pages.title: Jewel Monsters
pages.creator: IriySoft
pages.description: Jewel Monsters combines match-three puzzles with battles against creatures in a forest. Swap gems to form groups matching the current monster's color and damage it. Make enough matches quickly, since a surviving enemy will strike back if you take too long.

pages.title: Escape Kid
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Escape Kid mixes platform puzzles with a race for the next exit. Pass traps and other dangers, then fire the shot that activates the gate. Once the way is open, move quickly toward the escape and continue into the following stage.

pages.title: Ragdoll Fall
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Ragdoll Fall asks you to keep a falling ragdoll landing on platforms for points. Avoid saws and use the quick-drop move to catch the next surface. Time the descents so you do not miss a platform and end the run.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Golden Chests
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Golden Chests has you aim colored bubbles into matching groups to collect treasure chests. Plan where each shot lands and use power-ups to get past difficult arrangements. Clear the required targets while dealing with the challenges in each layout.

pages.title: Smart Pin Ball
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Smart Pin Ball gives you pin-controlled chambers containing colored and gray balls. Retract pins so the colored balls touch the gray ones and change them before reaching the flask. Solve thirty physics puzzles by choosing a safe release order.

pages.title: Warzone Strike
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Warzone Strike is a multiplayer shooter with 38 guns available for battles across different maps. Move between positions, crouch when needed, and fire on rival players. Buy and select weapons to change the equipment you take into the firefights.

pages.title: Funky Animals Coloring
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Funky Animals Coloring offers eight animal pictures and a palette of 23 colors. Pick shades and fill the drawings to build your own versions of the illustrations. Finish quickly for a better score, then save the colored picture if you wish.

pages.title: Mother Duck and Ducklings Jigsaw
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Mother Duck and Ducklings Jigsaw features twelve pictures of duck families for you to rebuild. Fit the scattered pieces together to reunite each mother duck with her ducklings in the image. Complete the different family scenes one puzzle at a time.

pages.title: Safe Sailor
pages.creator: Latimed
pages.description: Safe Sailor asks you to rescue sailors abandoning a ship while a pirate pursues them. Swipe a sailor into a jump, then move a lifeboat into position to catch him. Coordinate the launch and rescue so each sailor lands safely aboard.

pages.title: Buggy Race Obstacle
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Buggy Race Obstacle sends a buggy down a beach course with traffic and obstacles in the way. Change position to avoid collisions, which cost one of your four hearts. Travel as far as possible before the remaining hearts run out.

pages.title: Pixel Factory Battle 3D.IO
pages.creator: boboos
pages.description: Pixel Factory Battle 3D.IO puts you in a team shooting battle with blocky environments. Move around the arena, aim at opposing players, and fire to help your side win. Work with your team's objective while handling the firefights around you.

pages.title: Monster Truck Hidden Stars
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Monster Truck Hidden Stars hides ten stars inside each of six vehicle pictures. Search the scene and mark every star before the timer expires. Choose your clicks carefully, since repeated mistakes take time away from the remaining search.

pages.title: Shootup.io
pages.creator: LapaMauve
pages.description: Shootup.io strands you in a zombie-filled town where you can build defenses, drive vehicles, and fight other survivors. Find supplies or destroy houses to uncover them. Gunfire and cars attract zombies, while kills unlock improvements for your equipment and base.

pages.title: Rock Paper Scissors
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Rock Paper Scissors turns the familiar hand game into a race to three points. Choose one of the three symbols and try to anticipate your opponent's selection. Play with touch controls or use the two keyboard control sets for the contest.

pages.title: Stuntz Online
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Stuntz Online lets you drive stunt cars through multiplayer environments filled with platforms and obstacles. Choose among ten vehicles and three locations, with daytime and nighttime settings. Drift, boost, and launch your car across the courses while sharing the space with other drivers.

pages.title: Jetman Joyride
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Jetman Joyride sends a flying character through a hazardous journey filled with rocks, debris, mountains, and airborne objects. Keep moving while avoiding contact with the obstacles along the route. Your aim is to survive the flight for as long as possible.

pages.title: Zombie Virus FPS
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Zombie Virus FPS Survival gives you armed missions on a jungle map overrun by zombies. Move through the terrain, aim your guns, and eliminate the required enemies. Campaigns vary in difficulty and enemy numbers, with additional modes offering further shooting challenges.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Gingerbread House
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Gingerbread House follows Hazel helping a gingerbread man restore his home. Choose activity icons to rebuild features including the house, candy train, pool, and snow characters. Finish the different repairs and decorate the Christmas tree for the holiday setting.

pages.title: Go Travel Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Go Travel Puzzle offers six travel-themed images to reconstruct as jigsaws. Select a picture and choose a difficulty between sixteen and one hundred pieces. Arrange the scattered sections to restore the scene, using its details to connect neighboring pieces.

pages.title: Stickman Armed Assassin 3D
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Stickman Armed Assassin 3D sends an armed stick figure through combat missions against other stickmen. Use firearms, grenades, and close-range attacks while moving between standing, crouching, and prone positions. Switch equipment to deal with the enemies encountered across the stages.

pages.title: Tetriz
pages.creator: DiHits
pages.description: Tetriz presents the familiar falling-block puzzle in a gentler-paced form. Fit the different shapes together and complete rows to clear space on the board. Keep the stack manageable by choosing placements that leave useful gaps for the pieces that follow.

pages.title: Goldie Home Recovery
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Goldie Home Recovery asks you to nurse Goldie after an accident leaves her with a broken arm and leg. Follow the care activities she needs while resting at home. Help with her treatment and keep her comfortable during the recovery period.

pages.title: Sudoku
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Sudoku offers difficulty choices for both new and experienced number-puzzle players. Fill the empty squares using the given digits as clues, completing the grid without repeating numbers in its rows, columns, or regions. Select an easier puzzle or attempt a harder logical challenge.

pages.title: Fascinating Puzzle
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Fascinating Puzzle offers jigsaw pictures made from pieces with varied shapes and sizes. Examine the sections and fit them together to restore each image. The unusual piece outlines change how you search for connections while working toward the completed picture.

pages.title: Monster Truck 2020
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Monster Truck 2020 puts you behind the wheel of a large off-road truck for racing and stunt driving. Accelerate through rough terrain and use the vehicle's power to attempt daring maneuvers. Control the truck as you tackle the desert's driving challenges.

pages.title: Plumber World
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Plumber World asks you to supply water to a fantasy land by rotating pipe sections. Connect the reservoir to destinations such as houses, fountains, and pools. Fix gaps and leaks in the network so the water has a continuous route to every required endpoint.

pages.title: Vacation Summer Dress Up
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Vacation Summer Dress Up gives you a seaside wardrobe for styling a group of friends. Browse 225 fashion items and assemble outfits for their summer holiday. Choose clothes and accessories to prepare the girls for spending their vacation by the sea.

pages.title: Fire Truck Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Fire Truck Jigsaw has you reconstruct pictures of emergency vehicles from scattered puzzle pieces. Select a mode and begin with the first image, then continue to later pictures. Match the sections of each fire truck to complete the full set of puzzles.

pages.title: west shooter
pages.creator: juegocaca.com
pages.description: west shooter is a timed shooting challenge with zombie-themed targets and three purchasable weapons. Aim at the boards to score points and earn coins. Spend the money on extra time or change guns to keep the target-shooting session going.

pages.title: Simon Halloween
pages.creator: IDLA Games
pages.description: Simon Halloween tests your memory with a sequence of monster selections. Watch the order in which the characters are activated, then click them in the same order. Keep reproducing the pattern accurately as you follow the Halloween-themed sequence challenge.

pages.title: Spaceship Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Spaceship Memory Challenge asks you to uncover matching pictures of spacecraft. Turn over cards, remember the images you reveal, and select their partners to clear them. Finish the level by finding all the pairs hidden across the memory board.

pages.title: Army Vehicles Memory
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Army Vehicles Memory gives you four stages of military-vehicle picture matching. Flip two tiles at a time and remember their images to locate the pairs. Clear the whole board while trying to use as few moves as possible for each stage.

pages.title: Magikmon
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Magikmon follows an aspiring wizard through an entrance test at a magic school. Capture creatures and train a team to face wild monsters, hostile students, and teachers. Find your way through the school's shadowy gardens while developing your collection of magical companions.

pages.title: House Paint 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: House Paint 2 asks you to cover every white section of a house with color. Swipe in four directions to move the painting action through the layout. Work out a route that fills all the empty areas and completes the current house.

pages.title: EG Frog Escape
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Frog Escape traps a frog under falling boxes and stone slabs. Dodge incoming objects, then use the fallen stacks to climb toward the exit. Remember that heavier materials crush lighter ones, changing which platforms will remain available beneath your feet.

pages.title: Easter Egg Hunting
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Easter Egg Hunting has you guide a bunny through jumps while collecting eggs. Time the movement so the rabbit lands on its feet rather than falling incorrectly. Keep the attempt going and gather as many eggs as possible along the route.

pages.title: Forest Runner
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Forest Runner sends you through woodland in an endless running challenge. Avoid tree stumps, rocks, and other obstacles while trying to keep the run alive. Complete missions along the way as you continue farther into the forest course.

pages.title: Vintage vs Swag Fashion Battle
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Vintage vs Swag Fashion Battle pits Elsa's vintage style against Anna's bright, print-heavy swag look. Dress both princesses according to their chosen fashion directions and prepare their entries. Compare the lace and traditional accessories with the bolder colors of the rival outfit.

pages.title: Extreme Car Driving
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Extreme Car Driving lets you select a car and explore an empty city. Drive through the streets without a countdown or obstacle course directing the trip. Choose your own route and spend the session getting familiar with the car and surroundings.

pages.title: Letters Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Letters Memory Challenge gives you a board of concealed letter images to pair. Choose a level mode, reveal the tiles, and remember which letters appear in each position. Find all the matching images to clear the board and finish the round.

pages.title: Popular Autumn Fashion Styles
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Popular Autumn Fashion Styles puts you alongside a model shopping for a fall wardrobe. Act as her fashion consultant while browsing the seasonal clothing selection. Help with the makeover and combine the available pieces into an outfit for her autumn shopping day.

pages.title: Viking Brawl
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Viking Brawl offers sword duels against either the computer or a second player. Use the one-touch controls to jump and attack as the Vikings fight. Time your actions to strike the opponent while handling the movement of the cartoon battle.

pages.title: Mexican Wrestler Superstars
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Mexican Wrestler Superstars is a pose-repetition challenge set around a wrestler's photo shoots. Watch the combination shown and select the poses in the same order. A mistake restarts the sequence, while later combinations become longer and harder to reproduce accurately.

pages.title: The Galactic Maze
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: The Galactic Maze sends a starship through a survival flight across space. Move left and right with the arrow keys to control its route. Keep the ship's journey going for as long as possible while navigating the changing course ahead.

pages.title: Power Kids
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Power Kids asks you to choose a hero and stop Martians attacking Earth. Turn left or right to direct the character against the alien threats. Work through the attack while building your score and protecting the planet from the invading creatures.

pages.title: Bazooka Monster
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Bazooka Monster challenges you to eliminate enemies placed around physics-puzzle stages. Aim a rocket so it reaches the monsters directly or rebounds off useful objects. Find a firing route past the obstacles to destroy every target in the arrangement.

pages.title: Hex Zen
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Hex Zen gives you a hexagonal puzzle area and shaped pieces that must fit inside it. Examine the gaps and select the right positions for the available shapes. Rearrange the pieces until their combined outline fills the required pattern.

pages.title: Where's the Word?
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Where's the Word? challenges you to locate hidden words in a letter grid before time runs out. Scan the rows of letters and mark the words you discover. Complete searches to unlock more levels while trying to improve your best score.

pages.title: Super Girls Elements Quiz
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Super Girls Elements Quiz presents pairs of pictures and asks which better matches your current mood. Choose an image from each pair to build your result. Complete the ten selections to discover the character outcome assigned by the game's quiz.

pages.title: James Royal Bartender
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: James Royal Bartender has a young prince practicing mixology in the castle bar. Help him make two colorful, fruit-flavored cocktails for Amber and Sofia. Work through the drink-preparation activities to complete the recipes the pair have asked him to create.

pages.title: Real Street Basketball
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Real Street Basketball lets you shoot hoops through a series of basketball challenges. Drag and release the ball to direct it toward the basket, adjusting the movement for each throw. Practice the shots and work toward a better scoring total.

pages.title: Fancy Personal Tailor
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Fancy Personal Tailor combines a workshop search with designing an outfit for a customer. First locate the tools and materials you need among the room's objects. Then begin the clothing-design activities and create the lady's custom look from the gathered supplies.

pages.title: Highschool Prom Crush
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Highschool Prom Crush asks you to help Rachel find the belongings she needs before prom. Search for her missing things, then choose a dress and matching accessories. Complete the outfit once the search is finished so she is ready for the evening.

pages.title: Bff Fashion Stars
pages.creator: Daria Games
pages.description: Bff Fashion Stars lets you prepare two friends for a runway show. Style their hair, choose elegant clothing, and add glittering accessories to complete each look. Work through both makeovers to get the BFFs ready for their fashion-show appearance.

pages.title: Basketball Shots
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Basketball Shots gives you a basketball to aim and launch toward the hoop. Adjust the shot's direction and strength with the pointer before releasing it. Keep landing baskets to increase the score and try to beat your best shooting run.
